from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

router = APIRouter(prefix="/quic/transfers")

@router.get("/{transfer_id}/quic-stream")
async def stream_transfer_over_quic(
    transfer_id: str,
    transfer_service: QuicTransferService = Depends(get_quic_transfer_service),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    transfer = await transfer_service.get_transfer(transfer_id)
    if not transfer:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="QUIC transfer session not found")

    async def file_generator():
        async for chunk in transfer_service.iter_chunks(transfer):
            yield chunk

    return StreamingResponse(file_generator(), media_type="application/octet-stream")
diagnosis: The QUIC file transfer endpoint streams asset chunks using WebTransport/HTTP/3. The route looks up the transfer using transfer_id, but never validates whether transfer.tenant_id or transfer.user_id corresponds to current_user. An attacker can stream in-progress large file uploads or exported asset packages created by other tenants.

corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

router = APIRouter(prefix="/quic/transfers")

@router.get("/{transfer_id}/quic-stream")
async def stream_transfer_over_quic(
    transfer_id: str,
    transfer_service: QuicTransferService = Depends(get_quic_transfer_service),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    transfer = await transfer_service.get_transfer(transfer_id)
    if not transfer or transfer.tenant_id != current_user.tenant_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="QUIC transfer session not found")

    async def file_generator():
        async for chunk in transfer_service.iter_chunks(transfer):
            yield chunk

    return StreamingResponse(file_generator(), media_type="application/octet-stream")
